_about: What the writer produces for the Just Listed / Just Sold library (templates/announce). Values are the 2614 Calder sample. Facts come only from the listing fact sheet; no price, photo numbers or staging labels (the neighborhood is optional in the copy); plain sentences, no em dashes. Every block runs through the copy checks (annlib.js banned list + pipeline/copycheck.py) and the humanizer pass.

_fields.justListed.lead: one sentence, about 12 words, what the house is
_fields.justListed.hook: short feature line, 3-6 words, sentence case (shown in capitals on some designs)
_fields.justListed.hookTail: 3-5 words that finish the hook ("in a 1940 bungalow")
_fields.justListed.featuresShort: 8 bullets under 28 characters for front lists
_fields.justListed.captions: one caption per listing photo id, under 60 characters
_fields.justListed.master: the one master write-up for backs, 6-8 sentences; backs cut it to fit
_fields.justListed.drop: 1-based sentence numbers in the order they give way when a back is short on room (first sentence never listed)
_fields.justListed.photoRoles: optional {role: photo id} when the auto match is wrong (front, family, kitchen, dining, living, primary, lawn, nook, office, ...)
_fields.justSold.headline: agent pick: Just Sold | Another Home Sold | Sold | Listed & Sold | their own words
_fields.justSold.side: agent pick: seller | buyer | both | null
_fields.justSold.days / offers / offersOk / over: agent inputs; offer counts and over asking print only when offersOk is true
_fields.justSold.ctaHead / ctaNext / ctaShort /: from the CTA playbook or the agent's own words
_fields.justSold.master + drop: the master back write-up and its drop order
_fields.justSold.letter: the "Hello, neighbor" note, about 55 words, first person
_fields.justSold.nohsLines: three short lines that fill the headshot spot when the agent has no headshot
_fields.justSold.quote: only a real client quote the agent pastes with the client's OK; never written by AI
_fields.justListed.blurb: two sentences, 120-140 characters, for two-line write-ups on social posts

justListed.lead: A 1940 bungalow with new wiring, plumbing, roof and siding.
justListed.about: This 1940 bungalow in Houston has a new roof, new siding, and new wiring and plumbing. The kitchen has white upper cabinets, dark lower cabinets, marble-look counters and a bar that seats three. The living and dining rooms are open to each other, with a breakfast nook off the kitchen. The primary bedroom has a vaulted ceiling, and the back patio is covered.

master: This 1940 bungalow in Houston has a new roof, new siding, and new wiring and plumbing.
It has three bedrooms, two full baths and 1,385 square feet, all on one floor.
The front door opens to a living room that runs into the dining area, with wood-look floors throughout.
The kitchen has white upper cabinets, dark lower cabinets, marble-look counters, stainless appliances and a bar that seats three.
A breakfast nook with windows on two sides sits next to the kitchen.
The primary bedroom has a vaulted ceiling and a double-door closet.
